content.help: Link your sleeping with your party's, so everyone sleeps and wakes together.
The game hour (0 to 23) the party wakes up at.

content.text: Sleep until the wake-up hour unless I move the slider
content.help: On: if you leave the hours slider alone, everyone sleeps until your wake-up hour. If you move the slider, that many hours pass. Off: always use the slider.

content.text: Restore health, magicka and stamina after a shared sleep
content.help: Players recover when a shared sleep ends, like after a vanilla sleep.
